service.description: What the database db allows the Tools screens, and why the rest is not available ("needs the pg_monitor role", "pg_stat_statements is not loaded"), probed once and kept five minutes; refresh probes again. features maps each of statementStats, activity, cancel, terminate, lockWaits, tableSizes, bloatExact, indexUsage, indexOnline, fkLightLock, maintenance, integrity, settings, settingsEdit and backups to available and reason (why not, or what limits it). backend is embedded-postgres, postgres, mysql or mariadb. available is false, with reason, when the database did not answer.

Forget the entity facade's statement stats of this instance (entity-facade@query-stats), as ec.entity.clearQueryStats() does. Needs the DATABASE_ADMIN permission, and writes a DbaStatsReset DatabaseAudit row.

The statements of sqlText as a run with Allow Changes needs them confirmed: each with changes (it may change data), ownTransaction (VACUUM, CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, CREATE DATABASE: runs on its own) and implicitCommit (MySQL DDL); changeCount; and token, the one-time confirmation run#Sql takes for this user, db and sqlText, good for ten minutes. On a production instance confirmDatabaseName is the name run#Sql needs typed. parameterNames are the :name parameters.

Run sqlText, split into statements. Read only unless allowChanges, which needs the token of classify#Sql (spent by this run) and on production confirmDatabaseName. With changes the script is one transaction and stops at the first failure (rolledBack), unless eachOnOwn; a read-only script stops at its first failure too. parameters binds each :name as a value. limit rows per query (500, at most 100,000); offset fetches more of a single read-only query; timeoutSeconds (300, at most 3,600) cancels the statement running at the time. runId (8 to 36 letters, digits or -) names the run for cancel#SqlRun; one is made when empty. results has, per statement: seq, sql, givesRows, columns, records (lists of values), limitReached, rowsAffected, durationMs, error, rerunnable (a plain query run read only: may be run again to sort, filter or fetch more) and skipped.

Cancel the run runId: the user's own, or any with DATABASE_ADMIN. On this instance through its connection's canceller; a run on another instance is found by its running audit row and cancelled with pg_cancel_backend or KILL QUERY. outcome is cancelled, cancelledRemote (with instanceId and backendId) or notRunning. Writes a DbaCancel audit row.

The plan of one statement (§7.5): Postgres EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, VERBOSE, BUFFERS), MySQL and MariaDB EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON. analyze runs it: Postgres adds ANALYZE, MySQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE (format text), MariaDB ANALYZE FORMAT=JSON; a statement that may change data then needs the token of classify#Sql and runs in a transaction that is rolled back (rolledBack). plan is the database's text (JSON when format is json).

The SQL editor's completion schema: tables (table name to its column names, a table outside the connection's schema as schema.table), entities (each entity of the group to its table) and dialect (postgres or mysql).

The database's own statement stats (§7.2), the most costly first, at most limit (100, at most 1,000). Postgres pg_stat_statements: query_id, query, calls, total_exec_time, mean_exec_time, rows, shared_blks_hit, shared_blks_read, temp_blks_written (milliseconds). MySQL and MariaDB events_statements_summary_by_digest: query_id, query, calls, sum_timer_wait (picoseconds), sum_rows_examined, sum_no_index_used. When they do not read, available is false with the reason of get#Capabilities.
Reset the database's own statement stats: pg_stat_statements_reset(), or a TRUNCATE of the digest table. Needs DATABASE_ADMIN; writes a DbaStatsReset audit row.

The current user's own SQL audit rows, newest first (limit 50, at most 500), of db when given: the SQL screen's history. Each has auditId, db, statementText, isChange, rowsReturned, rowsAffected, durationMs, errorText and startTime.
The user's own saved queries and the shared ones (of db when given), by description: queryId, description, db, sqlText, ownerUserId, isShared, parametersJson.
Create a saved query (no queryId), owned by the current user, or update one the user owns. parametersJson, when given, is JSON (the :name parameters' defaults).
Delete a saved query the current user owns.
Delete the DatabaseAudit rows older than the database_audit_days property (90 by default, at least 1): the DatabaseAuditPurge ServiceJob.
